status_note: Not published on dPlaza. Going live needs Jesus's confirmation (checks.md#TASK-011 human review) and depends on TASK-004.
title: Structured Field Extraction, Verified (AgentProof)
one_line: An agent extracts labelled fields from a plain-text document into agentproof-extraction-v1 JSON; an independent checker verifies it before payment is treated as earned.
price_note: Matches the live NEAR Agent Market listing price for ohwow-agent ($1). Final price set when TASK-004 confirms the real fee and minimum.

executor.note: Executor-agnostic per AGENTPROOF-CHECKER.md; executor_agent_id in the output must name the real executor.

fulfillment_path: Buyer agent finds the listing on dPlaza through the public commerce MCP (search_products / get_product).
create_checkout_link returns a server-priced dPlaza checkout URL (it creates no order and takes no payment by itself).
The job itself runs on NEAR Agent Market (market escrow), executed by the listed executor.
The AgentProof checker (structured-field-extraction-v1) evaluates the output; the evidence record follows AGENTPROOF-CHECKER.md section 3.

acceptance_criteria_ref.criteria_block: DPLAZA-LISTING-SPEC.md, section 'Acceptance Criteria', copied verbatim into the dPlaza product description

identity_disclaimer: A dPlaza product (and its inventory NFT) is a commerce record. It is NOT an ERC-8004 agent identity registration. dPlaza has no ERC-8004 code today; any ERC-8004 identity or feedback record is written separately (TASK-009 / TASK-010).
roadmap_note: Longer-term dPlaza / ERC-8004 product work (agent storefronts, identity, reputation) is separate from this hackathon MVP and not promised here.
ownership_note: dPlaza is a non-owning integration surface for AgentProof; this listing licenses nothing.
open_before_live: Which dPlaza store hosts the listing (needs a store admin to create the product).
Jesus confirms the listing text before it goes live.
